plan.summary: Raises the upload retry limit from 3 to 5 attempts in `config/upload.yaml`. The `backoff_ms` value stays at 200. A comment-only edit in the same file is left out.
plan.riskRationale: One config value changes. More retries can increase load on the upload service during failures, but no logic changes.
plan.storyArc: One config change: uploads now retry up to five times instead of three.

topics.title: Increase upload max_attempts to 5
topics.narrativeBrief: What does the retry setting change? `retry.max_attempts` goes from 3 to 5 while `backoff_ms` stays 200. Verify how the uploader reads this value and whether the 200 ms backoff is fixed or grows between attempts.
